        UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.BrownianProjectiveSource.sourceLaw =

        ((1 / 2 *
            ∫ (ω : NNReal → ℝ),
              H ω ^ 2 ∂UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.BrownianProjectiveSource.sourceLaw) *

    InformationTheory.klDiv
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.map readout
          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.BrownianPastStepExponentialSource.stepLaw H a b))
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.map readout
          UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.BrownianProjectiveSource.sourceLaw) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal
        ((1 / 2 *
            ∫ (ω : NNReal → ℝ),
              H ω ^ 2 ∂UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.BrownianProjectiveSource.sourceLaw) *
          (↑b - ↑a))

  [MeasurableSpace Γ] {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] {P0 Q : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  {T : NNReal} {u : ℝ → Ω → E} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P0] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  (h : UEOT.V3.GirsanovPathKL.TerminalGirsanovData P0 Q T u) (statePath : Ω → Γ) (hstate : Measurable statePath) :
  InformationTheory.klDiv Q P0 = ENNReal.ofReal (2⁻¹ * ∫ (ω : Ω), UEOT.V3.GirsanovPathKL.controlEnergy T u ω ∂Q) ∧
    InformationTheory.klDiv (MeasureTheory.Measure.map statePath Q) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map statePath P0) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2⁻¹ * ∫ (ω : Ω), UEOT.V3.GirsanovPathKL.controlEnergy T u ω ∂Q)
